comments.value: I think this panders to favoritism, and a subjective way of titling people.
please dont do it. Not only because it shows people as being targets for trolling but it also can create a potential devide between users as priviledged groups.

Maybe there could be a way to indicate that somebody is streaming, but I'd avoid giving out 'titles' to know streamers because of multiple reasons;

It doesn't do much apart from segregate streamers from non streamers
It makes streamers easy targets for malicious attacks
It would clutter up the nametag area

My suggestion: allow a mode you can toggle where you can indicate that you are streaming, such as like a red flashing dot on the side of a nametag. I think there should also be an option where you can block your avatar to people who are streaming in case you don't want to be seen on a stream. However this would be dependant on people turning on the mode before they start a stream.
I would not add this to be honest. It will just cause people using it to flex on others or people saying racist stuff when they see a streamer. Would probably not be a good idea...
We're looking at options to allow streamers to be more effective.
oh look an easier way to stream snipe for hackers
Oh goodie, entitlement. Great way to cause more problems
